title: Agroforestry for landscape restoration and livelihood resilience
authors: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
methodology: FAO synthesis of agroforestry functions in production landscapes.
limitations: Species and spacing must be locally adapted; water competition is a recognized risk in drylands.

chunks.text: Agroforestry introduces structural diversity into farmland, creating habitat layers, windbreaks, and additional organic inputs through litter and roots. In dry regions, widely spaced, drought-adapted trees or shrubs on boundaries can improve habitat connectivity with lower crop competition than dense in-field planting. Biodiversity and soil-carbon benefits accrue over years rather than a single season.
